why_it_matters: 33 data segments (32 embedded 1024 B constant slabs + 1 external) exceed the old 24-segment cap. The current tri-state subset_sum_match returns True; the pre-E24b implementation, which kept only the first 24 segments, returns False -- i.e. it would have written a FALSE 'NOT matched' statement into this honest contract. harness/contract_negative_tests.py pins both verdicts against this preserved bundle.
